name: CBD Life Sciences Inc.
summary: CBD Life Sciences Inc. specializes in formulating and distributing a broad array of organic items infused with cannabidiol. Their extensive range of natural CBD offerings includes hemp tinctures, topical massage oils, targeted recovery and pain relief balms, dietary aids to support anxiety and restful sleep, various consumable treats, and a dedicated collection of products for animal companions. The company's principal operations are conducted from Scottsdale, Arizona.
